myData.sub
#Stap 3: lavaan
install.packages("lavaan")
library(lavaan)
#Stap 4: model specifiëren (latente variabelen en regressies)
myModel <- 'cause_ind ~ con
cause_hum ~ con
PCE ~ cause_ind+cause_hum
PCE=~q24_3+q24_4
con=~q25_1+q25_2+q25_3+q25_4+q25_5+q25_6

fit <- sem(myModel, data=myData.sub)

messages.author: 288035dcf790fe3f
messages.subject: Re: no information about regressions in output
parts:
without looking at your code, this error means that you have selected variables in your model that do not exist in your data set. R is case-sensitive which means that a variable name 'variable' is not the same as a variable called 'Variable' (mind the first capital letter).  Check the case of the variable names in your model.

To avoid confusion, whenever I receive a data set using variable names with mixed upper and lower case letters I set them all to lower case  ( names(data) <- tolower(names(data)) ).

j
